FY 2024-25 Details of improvements in environmental and social impacts

0.01% Investments in advanced analytical and simulation equipment (such as SEM-EDS, AGR line simulator, and spectrophotometer) have enabled improved defect analysis, process optimisation, and quality control. This has resulted in reduced material wastage, enhanced resource efficiency, and lower environmental impact of production processes.

2.76% Capex investments have been directed towards enhancing environmental performance through increased cullet utilisation, installation of cullet sorting machine and dust collection systems, energy-efficient technologies (VFDs, efficient cooling systems), water conservation initiatives (rainwater harvesting), and renewable energy enablement. Additionally, significant investments have been made in strengthening workplace safety (fire protection systems, gas leakage detection, collision prevention systems) and improving employee well-being through better infrastructure and facilities.
